items.html: Andrew Poynter made 69 international appearances for Ireland in an eight-year career, making his debut against Bangladesh A in 2008. A Clontarf man, he scored 989 runs at 19.31, with a top score of 77 coming against Afghanistan during Ireland's successful World Cricket League campaign in 2010. He also played in two T20 World Cups - in Bangladesh in 2014, and India in 2016 - one of them alongside his younger brother Stuart. He retired at 29 to concentrate on a business and his role as head of youth coaching at Clontarf CC.
